summary: Frontend-only E2E test of Aura mock app. Ran signup → consent → check-in → results → chat → sidebar → settings → mobile → logout. Nearly all flows work. Two issues: (1) 'Save & finish later' produces a redirect loop back to /onboarding/checkin because the useProfile React Query cache is not invalidated after updateMe({assessment_status:'in_progress'}), so the Gate guard still sees 'not_started' and redirects. (2) Signup spec requires a show/hide password toggle (auth-password-toggle), but no such testid or toggle button exists in the UI. All mock triggers (test-high, test-imminent, test-error, test-limit) work correctly. Crisis modal shows US 988 resources + intl link. Theme=night and accent=sage persist in html data-attributes. Mobile drawer opens via mobile-menu-button. Session titles are correctly derived from the first 4 words (title-cased) of the first user message. No console errors observed.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Save & finish later' does not reach /app/chat: after profileService.updateMe({assessment_status:'in_progress'}) the useProfile query cache is NOT invalidated. The Gate guard reads stale p.assessment_status === 'not_started' on /app and redirects back to /onboarding/checkin. The setMeStatus() local state update is insufficient — need to invalidate/setQueryData for the ['profile'] query (or await refetch) before navigate('/app/chat').
Missing show/hide password toggle. Spec expects a toggle to switch input type between password and text; no button rendered and no data-testid='auth-password-toggle'. Login likely has same gap.
Because of bug #1, the finish-checkin-banner on /app/chat could not be verified. Once the redirect loop is fixed the banner needs to render for users whose assessment_status='in_progress'.

action_items: Fix 'Save & finish later' redirect loop: after profileService.updateMe(...) in Checkin.saveLater(), invalidate or setQueryData for the ['profile'] React Query so Gate on /app sees fresh assessment_status='in_progress'. Same applies to skip() which currently works only because assessment_status='skipped' also isn't 'not_started' — verify no similar staleness.
Add show/hide password toggle to Signup and Login with data-testid='auth-password-toggle' (spec requirement).
Confirm finish-checkin-banner (data-testid='finish-checkin-banner') renders on /app/chat when profile.assessment_status === 'in_progress'.
critical_code_review_comments: guards.tsx Gate depends on useProfile cache; any code path that mutates profile MUST invalidate/setQueryData(['profile']) before navigate, otherwise the guard bounces the user back. This is a general pattern risk across Consent/Settings too.
Consider using queryClient.setQueryData(['profile'], updated) or invalidateQueries + await refetch inside profileService wrapper hooks so future callers can't forget.

rca of the issue: 'Save & finish later': Checkin.saveLater() calls profileService.updateMe({assessment_status:'in_progress'}) then setMeStatus('in_progress') then navigate('/app/chat'). The Gate guard on /app reads profile via useProfile() (React Query key ['profile']). setMeStatus is a local zustand/store setter but useProfile's cache still holds the pre-update profile with assessment_status='not_started'. Gate then executes `stage === 'app' && p.assessment_status === 'not_started'` → Navigate to /onboarding/checkin. Reproduction: signup → complete consent → answer 1-2 questions → click 'Save & finish later'. Expected: land on /app/chat with finish-checkin-banner visible. Actual: bounced back to /onboarding/checkin resuming at question 2. Mitigation: In the updateMe call site (or inside a useUpdateProfile mutation) do `queryClient.setQueryData(['profile'], updated)` or `await queryClient.invalidateQueries({queryKey:['profile']}); await queryClient.refetchQueries(...)` before navigating.
